Its derivative is a strictly positive prefactor times F(T-t)-G(t), where F and G are both strictly increasing on positive arguments. This guarantees one and only one interior global maximizer, with no numerical uniqueness inference. Implicit differentiation gives 0<t_T prime<1; exact short-time expansion and large-time exponential balance prove all stated limits. The independent integration checker passes 1600 random cases plus global grid, derivative and horizon-limit checks. Limits: only the stated positive constant-rate irreversible model is proved.

value.rationale: The ecological decision is not an arbitrary parameter slice: opening habitat too soon exposes it to secondary invasion before a native seed source exists; opening it too late prevents timely recolonization. The exact universal strict-interior theorem, monotonic horizon response, singular no-invader boundary, quadratic-short/linear-long timing law, and nonvanishing asymptotic success gain resolve a natural time-staging question in a minimal model. It provides a meaningful benchmark without asserting policy calibration.
